acceptance_predicates.description: Guided ASB commands emit human-readable output by default without secret or credential material.
Supported commands accept --json and compatibility --format json selectors with stable machine envelopes.
Unknown and malformed options fail with typed actionable diagnostics and do not echo secrets.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes focused output-contract tests and all required hosted checks.
Independent review verifies human default, JSON opt-in, aliases, and redaction.
Post-merge receipt records exact protected-main head and exact-main checks.

inputs.description: ASB install, setup, benchmark, recording, replay, comparison, status, doctor, and removal commands.

outputs.description: Command matrix, human-readable defaults, stable JSON selectors, typed negatives, and credential-free diagnostics.

gates.description: All required PR and exact-main checks pass on the merged head.
